basis_and_limitations.why_it_matters: Unlike pipe, plate generally has no separate B36-type dimensional standard. General requirements and material grade must both be shown.
basis_and_limitations.minimum_decision_check: Confirm SA-20/SA-480 or the applicable material-specific specification.

basis_and_limitations.requirement: Do not convert pipe grade directly to plate grade
basis_and_limitations.why_it_matters: Product form, heat treatment, toughness, allowable stress and manufacturing route differ.
basis_and_limitations.minimum_decision_check: Verify the exact ASME Section II material record accepted by the governing ASME VIII edition.

basis_and_limitations.why_it_matters: Impact-test exemptions and toughness depend on material, thickness, heat treatment and minimum design metal temperature.
basis_and_limitations.minimum_decision_check: Document MDMT, governing thickness and impact-test basis.

basis_and_limitations.why_it_matters: Corrosion, wet H2S, hydrogen attack, chloride SCC, sulfidation, naphthenic acid and caustic service may govern over strength.
basis_and_limitations.minimum_decision_check: Complete material selection report and damage-mechanism review.

basis_and_limitations.why_it_matters: Many SA-387 and other plate specifications include classes and mandatory heat-treatment conditions.
basis_and_limitations.minimum_decision_check: Select class, normalized/tempered or Q&T condition and PWHT basis.

basis_and_limitations.why_it_matters: Allowable stress is product-form, grade, class, condition, thickness and temperature specific.
basis_and_limitations.minimum_decision_check: Perform a fail-closed Section II-D lookup.

basis_and_limitations.why_it_matters: A technically suitable grade may still create procurement, fabrication, repair and spare-part risk.
basis_and_limitations.minimum_decision_check: Compare CAPEX, fabrication complexity, lead time, inspection and lifecycle cost.
